text:
maria: FYI starting a staggered unpin tonight 23:30 UTC for runtime 3.2 -> 3.3 in APAC. This affects model groups: longseq, conv-q. Will do cohorted waves per region. Please ack if you have blocks.

alex: ack. what's the success gate? latency and error budgets?

maria: primary gate = p95 latency <= 1200ms and errors < 0.5% for 15m moving window. Also check kv-cache hit rate doesn't drop >5%.

deploy-bot: @channel schedule created: unpin-wave-1 APAC-sg 23:30UTC, wave-2 APAC-tok 00:00UTC, wave-3 EU 02:00UTC. Command: `deploybot unpin --runtime=3.3 --cohort=apac-sg --dry-run=false`

vikram: note SDK consumers on nightshift are on sdk 2.13; sdk 2.14 has header change for kv-prefetch—confirm compatible fallback present.

maria: good catch. we're enabling shim in wave-1: `runtime.flag.kv_prefetch=legacy` to avoid SDK mismatch. plan to remove shim only after telemetry clear.

karen: what's rollback criteria? if p95 >1200 or tail errors spike we abort and pin back? timeline for pinback?

sre-bot: Runbook snippet: on abort -> `deploybot pin --runtime=3.2 --target=cohort` -> notify #incidents and run automated perf-dump. Pinback should complete within 7m median.

alex: can we throttle waves if backend queue spikes? suggesting adding a 20% gradual traffic ramp in the deploybot command.

maria: yes add `--ramp=20%` to the command. Also setting telemetry hooks: `obs.route:unpin_wave_1` for devex to watch.

vikram: I'll watch canary logs and run the smoke eval suite (prompt set: longseq-regression-2026). If we see hallucination rate >2% hold.

maria: perfect. final checklist: docs updated, release notes draft + changelog entry, slack oncall ping, and the escape hatch command in top of runbook. proceeding in 8m. :rocket:

alex: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Wave-1 started APAC-sg -> runtime 3.3; tracking p95: 980ms, errors 0.12%, kv-hit 91% — will report updates every 5m.
